# A contested category is cheaper to sell into than an empty one

`sales.heu.market_research.crowded_beats_empty` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> A contested category is cheaper to sell into than an empty one.
 Competitors have already convinced the buyer the category exists, created the budget line and taught the internal justification. In an empty category we pay for all of that ourselves, in cycle length, before anyone compares us to anything. Emptiness is a cost that reads as an opportunity.
